name: edrProtectedWorkstationCount
definition: The number of workstations in the vendor's endpoint inventory that count as protected under the same EDR coverage transform's requiredCoveragePercentage rule.
population: protected workstations. Class rule per vendor: CrowdStrike product_type_desc Workstation (product_type 1 when the description is absent); SentinelOne machineType desktop or laptop; Defender osPlatform a Windows client version (Windows10, Windows11, ...) or macOS (ruling 2026-10-16). The denominator and the protected test are exactly the ones the same transform uses for requiredCoveragePercentage, so the split agrees with the blended figure.
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of the device inventory. Null when the read is partial or failed.

changeLog.change: Registered with the EDR server / workstation coverage split added to four EDR coverage transforms under edr* names (additive; no requirement reads it yet).

notes: Supporting count for the server / workstation coverage split; not a criterion on its own today.
